Film in Amsterdam this week

16 – 22 Nov · 16 events

Special screenings, film nights, pop-up cinemas and small festivals. A good pick for film lovers who look beyond the regular cinema schedule, with classics, documentaries, shorts and screenings followed by a talk or Q&A. The list is refreshed every week, so there is usually something new to see. Every listing is checked on the organiser's own page. Times and prices can change, so check the organiser's link before you go.

  1. Film, Food & Solidarity: Pride (2014) at QueerHub Nieuw-West

    Film · Queer · Food

    When
    Mon 16 Nov, 18:00–21:30 (meal 18:30, film 19:00)
    Where
    QueerHub Nieuw-West, Notweg 38, Amsterdam (Nieuw-West)
    Price
    Free incl. meal; register
    Organiser

  3. Cinema Culinair: film & dinner or brunch at Tolhuis

    Film · Food · Regular

    When
    Tue 17 – Sun 22 Nov, dinners: doors 18:00, film 19:00 (Tue Chef, Wed Estômago, Fri Burnt). Brunches: doors 11:30, film 12:30 (Sat Charlie and the Chocolate Factory, Sun The Grand Budapest Hotel). Thu, Sat and Sun dinners sold out (waitlist)
    Where
    Tolhuis, Buiksloterweg 7, Amsterdam (Noord)
    Price
    €69.95–€89.95 p.p. (brunch €69.95, film & dinner from €89.95); ticket shop totals up to €91.50
